title: Routine tracker and planner
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y7 lesson 7 (Routine tracker and planner (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 7: Sleep, screens and healthy routines. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Screens and sleep
points: Blue light delays the sleep hormone melatonin

blocks.h: A healthy day for an online learner

bullets: Screens off an hour before bed

keywords.def: things we do regularly at set times
light from screens that can delay sleepiness

questions.a: Same bedtime, screens off an hour before, dark cool room.

questions.q: Core: Track yesterday: screen time, sleep, activity. Then plan a better day (pupil PDF).
questions.a: Honest record and an improved, realistic plan.

questions.q: Extend: In the portal response box, persuade a friend to charge their phone outside the bedroom. Use two reasons.
questions.a: Blue light delays melatonin; notifications wake you; better sleep helps learning.

questions.q: Stretch: Explain how the teenage body clock and Fajr both affect bedtime choices.
questions.a: The body clock shifts later, but waking for Fajr means an earlier bedtime is needed for enough sleep.

questions.q: How much sleep do teenagers need?
questions.a: B) 8 to 10 hours. NHS guidance for teenagers is about 8 to 10 hours.

questions.q: Blue light from screens can... A) help you sleep B) delay sleepiness C) do nothing
Big question: is feeling awake late laziness or biology?
questions.a: Partly biology (the body clock shifts), so good routines matter.
